operation.body:
### Goal

Complete the **final documentation consistency pass** for project #2 so completion criteria match delivered behaviour on `main` after FR-008 (PR #27 / goal #26).

### Acceptance criteria

- Update `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` **Purpose and current stage** (and any other stale stage lines) to describe the implemented Feedback Inbox on `main`, not “implementation has not started”.
- Update root `AGENTS.md` so it no longer states that application implementation has not started; point readers to delivered app context on `main`.
- Update `.ai/project/roadmap.md` to mark **Reproducible demo (FR-008)** complete with goal #26 / PR #27 links, and reflect that product FR-001–FR-008 are delivered pending Project Executor final close of #2.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` (goal #3).
- Run `bin/rails db:test:prepare test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Branch name includes `issue-<n>`; one reviewable PR.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met.

### Out of scope

Application behaviour changes, new features, `docs/security-review.md`, CI workflow changes, and project issue #2 closure (Project Executor owns completion marker).

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-008 are implemented on `main` (goals #5–#26, PRs #7–#27). PR #27 updated README, demo guide, product context, and roadmap partially; `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` still claim implementation has not started. See project #2 completion criteria and FR-008 acceptance details in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md`.

<!-- project-executor:goal project=szymoniwacz/feedback-inbox#2 -->
operation.title: [Agent Goal]: Final documentation consistency (project close prep)
